description: Golden stem-name corpus for classify_name. Expected categories are product intent, not current behaviour. Do not expand CATEGORY_KEYWORDS without updating this file.

schema.name: filename including extension
schema.tags: clear | trap | priority | policy | gap | stretch
schema.note: optional rationale, especially for policy rows
schema.enforce: optional bool; false = documented intent only, skipped by the golden test

cases.name: sc_bus.wav
